messages.text: BL-1824 🎵 in progress — BL-1093's acceptance handler looks for a coordinator nudge whose message starts with the ticket id, but BL-1223 (6797c580fa, 2026-08-29) prefixed the unassigned-active nudge with "Work ", so scenario 01's four rows are red on main - the handler recognises the nudge the sweep actually sends, and BL-1093's feature is 8 of 8 again
